summary: The global marketing team is executing a two-track push: finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and ramping up search/AI visibility for Asia Star and Intelligent China, while resolving an Outlook lockout and clearing a backlog of event and report approvals due this week.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting team access; the fix requires deleting and re-adding accounts, updating passwords across devices, and confirming the backend unlock with CKGSB—this must be resolved before other work can proceed smoothly. The Knowledge website redesign is in final review: the team has chosen the current layout with improved menu categorization and article page enhancements, and Joseph, Julie, and the team lead need to hold a 30-minute working session to mark specific feedback before Joker implements changes. On the global marketing strategy front, Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top priorities for search and AI visibility, with Joseph tasked to draft target areas and profile Asia Star participants, while the Google Ads conversion tracking audit is pending. This week also demands attention to several time-sensitive items: reviewing the warm-up video script for the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum, following up on the Q3 2026 Business Sentiment Index English report approval, and stepping up registration outreach for the Nov 13 European Chamber event. Looking ahead, Joseph will review the Flow Asia 2026 report and discuss 2027 website/SEM plans with Gontran next week, and the team should consider Development Reimagined for China-Africa speakers when planning next year's events after WIL.
